executive_summary: Overall ad performance for July 2026 shows strong engagement with an average CTR of 3.87%, but significant volatility in lead acquisition costs. While the 'JULY ADS 2026' campaign achieved a peak CTR of 5.23%, the cost per message fluctuated between 45.70 and 317.71. The L300 and Mirage G4 models remain the primary drivers of volume, though current costs per message are higher than early 2026 historical benchmarks (approx. 17.00). Total spend is concentrated in Sales and Leads outcomes, with a notable shift toward higher CPMs (363.62) compared to previous periods.

best_campaigns.reason: Highest daily CTR (5.23%) and produced the most messages (7) on its best performing day (July 3rd) at a competitive cost of 45.70 per message.
Achieved the lowest recent cost per message of 41.28 on July 20th and shows higher consistency in the Leads objective compared to Sales-focused campaigns.

worst_campaigns.reason: Inconsistent performance with a high cost per message (141.21 historical avg) and zero messages generated on high-spend days like July 16th (204.66 spend).
Wasted spend historically with a very high cost per message of 167.41 and low CTR (1.32%) compared to July's 3%+ benchmarks.

winning_ads.performance: CTR of 5.68% and Cost Per Message of 44.32. This creative is the strongest performer in the current lineup.
Drove the majority of message volume in early July, specifically when focused on low DP offers.

creative_insights.insight: Mirage G4 with specific monthly payment callouts (₱15K+/Month) generates the highest CTR and lowest lead cost. Price-point transparency is driving intent.
L300 remains the brand's efficiency workhorse. Historical data shows L300 campaigns (March/April) achieved costs per message as low as 16.84.
Video ads (Client Release Video) are used but underperforming compared to static 'Offer-driven' images in the current Sales/Leads sets.

historical_insights.observation: Performance was significantly better in Q2 2026 with cost per message for L300 Sales at 17.13, compared to current July costs exceeding 90.00.
CPM has ballooned to 363.62 in late July. Historical 2023/2024 campaigns frequently operated at CPMs under 150.00, suggesting increased competition or creative fatigue.

recommendations.suggestion: Move budget away from 'Sales | Multi Models' (141.21/message) and reallocate to the 'Leads | Multi Models' campaign, specifically targeting the Mirage G4 ad set.
Re-introduce the L300 Business Promo style that worked in March (17.13 cost per message). The current July creative for L300 is not hitting the same efficiency.
Pause the July Sales campaign on days where CPC exceeds 11.00. Use the July 3rd 'Winning Formula' (CTR > 5%) as the benchmark for turning ads back on.
Test narrowing the 'Metro South' audience for Sales objectives. The current 18-65 range may be too broad given the high CPMs; focus on the 30-50 age bracket for L300 business owners.
